name: Impetus of Hephaestus
description:
You can [effect:hand][dark-gray]hand-forge[/dark-gray][/effect] artisan weapons using up to [red]2 materials[/red]/[blue]1 gem[/blue]. They're unenchantable and low durability, but deal high damage, apply [gradient:blue:red]bonus effects[/gradient], and [effect:strike][orange]🔨strike the iron[/orange][/effect] every 10th hit:

  • [blue]Gem[/blue]: 🔨[effect:stack][orange]Stack[/orange][/effect] the gem's stat.

  • [red]Wood[/red]: Attacks 20% faster or [orange]🔨50% faster for 5 seconds[orange].

  • [red]Stone[/red]: Attacks apply a brief or [orange]🔨2 second [term:stun]stun[/orange][/term].

  • [red]Gold[/red]: Kills drop +3x of [orange]🔨+5x[/orange] loot.

  • [red]Iron[/red]: Chain 2❤️ volcanic lightning or [orange]🔨an 8❤️ eruption[/orange].

  • [red]Diamond[/red]: [orange]🔨Stack forged gems stats twice[/orange].

  • [red]Netherite[/red]: 3x durability. Can forge with 3 [red]materials[/red] and [blue]gems[/blue].

[dark-gray]"Show them that practice make more than perfect."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Right-click a weapon material onto a stick in your inventory to forge a sword, or shift right click to forge an axe. Further materials and gems can be right-clicked onto an artisan weapon to forge them in. Artisan weapons can contain 2 materials and 1 gem by default. Forged gems are dropped when the weapon breaks.
Luck stacks up to 8 times. Attacks with non-artisan weapons cause stacks to decay.
